This guide covers Brute-force on wp-login beperken. You work in shop admin (products/checkout), focusing on brute, force, login — not unrelated side quests in other menus.

Preparation

  • Access to shop admin (products/checkout)
  • Focus of this article: brute, force, login
  • Recent backup or snapshot

Steps

  1. Open shop admin (products/checkout) and look specifically for settings around brute, force, login.
  2. Backup or staging; open shop admin.
  3. Change products/feed/checkout that belong to brute.
  4. Exclude cart/checkout from full-page cache.
  5. Walk through a test order that hits force.
  6. Rotate credentials tied to brute, force, login if abuse was possible.
  7. Schedule monitoring or a follow-up check.

Verify

  • Result for brute, force, login matches “Brute-force on wp-login beperken”
  • No regression on a critical flow beside brute force op wp
  • External test or second browser/network confirms the result

Tip: Work in small steps: get brute, force, login right first, then optional extras.

Note: Do not blindly change production without a backup if brute, force, login touches login, DNS, mail or payments.

Still stuck? Open a ticket with TripleZero iT via the client panel. Include your domain name, what you already tried, and any exact error messages (text or screenshot).
